events.title: Winter Solstice
events.startMessage: The longest night of the year! A warm Solstice recipe appeared in the book.
events.successMessage: Solstice Ember Brew! That will keep the dungeon warm all night.

recipe.bookText:
WINTER SOLSTICE - two nights only!
1. POUR to the silver band.
2. Ember Root, HEATED.
3. Sun Honey, ~~~~~~~~~ (wax dripped on the page).
4. MIX twice, then SERVE.

events.title: Full Moon Night
events.startMessage: The full moon is up! A special recipe appeared in the book: the Silver Moon Draught.
events.successMessage: Full Moon Night: you brewed the Silver Moon Draught!

recipe.bookText:
FULL MOON SPECIAL
1. POUR to the silver band.
2. Silver Dew, just as it is.
3. Moonstone, ~~~~~~ (moonlight hides the word).
4. MIX ~~ times and SERVE.
